text:
Anya: quick experiment idea — combine a soft credit gate on landing + a prompt-template carousel in onboarding, then follow up with an optional webinar invite. goal: get people to try templates and generate once. thoughts? :rocket:
Miguel: like it. what conversion metric do we prioritize? activation (first successful generation) or webinar RSVPs?
Anya: prioritize activation (first-gen) and then 7-day retention. RSVP is secondary but useful for high-intent leads.
Olivia: we should define events up front: landing_click, carousel_open, template_used, first_generation, credit_awarded, webinar_rsvp. tag cohort = "credit-gate-v1".
Sam: engineering note — we can do a soft gate client-side: landing -> modal carousel -> select template -> prefilled prompt inserted into editor -> user hits generate -> award credits via /credits/redeem. can share config snippet.
Sam: ```json
{
  "experiment": "template-credit-gate-v1",
  "variants": ["control","soft_gate"],
  "reward": 2000,
  "award_event": "first_generation_template_used"
}
```
Miguel: recommend A/B with 70/30 split and daily caps. route high-volume API keys out of the test to protect budget.
Anya: marketing copy thought for landing headline: "Ship with AI — try our prompt templates + get $20 in credits when you generate your first result." CTA: "Try a template"
Olivia: add a small tooltip on carousel: "Templates crafted for product demos, search, & support. Click to preview."
Sam: tagging/telemetry: include experiment_id on all metric events and in credit redemption. also guard against double-awards.
analytics-bot: created experiment tracker: https://redwood.analytics/experiments/template-credit-gate-v1 — metric targets: first_gen uplift +8% (p0), 7-day retention +4% (p1).
Anya: timeline proposal: creative done by Thu, dev PR Thu-Fri, QA Mon, soft launch Tue next week. @Miguel can you own landing assets + variants?
Miguel: yep — will drop copy + 3 headline variants by Wed EOD.
Olivia: i'll add the events to the spec doc and ping data infra for dashboards.
Sam: i'll open the PR draft and tag for review. concern: credit abuse — propose limit one award per account and 24h cooldown on reapply.
Anya: agree. add simple fraud filters (very low-entropy inputs, repeat device fingerprints) to hold credits for manual review.
Miguel: can we surface a subtle webinar upsell after first_gen? inline banner: "See how teams use templates — join our live workshop"
Anya: perfect. i'll synthesize this into a 1-pager and post in #marketing tomorrow. :memo:
